fact: A blue supergiant at Orion's knee — Rigel's hotter, fainter-looking twin.
bio: Saiph (Kappa Orionis) is a blue supergiant roughly 650 light-years away, marking the lower-left corner of Orion opposite Rigel. It is comparable to Rigel in size and heat, but appears fainter to us because much of its fierce output pours out as invisible ultraviolet light.
cultural: The name comes from the Arabic for 'sword'. Saiph and Rigel are the two 'feet' of the Hunter, framing the base of one of the most recognisable figures in the sky.
